currentRoundInspection.scope: Four actually inspected2009 courtyard/prayer-facade/minaret pictures plus standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. Historical exterior approximation;current reconstruction state unverified. No bespoke surveys or redistributed photographs.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Pale masonry prayer-hall courtyard facade with tall timber/glazed lower fields,pointed lattice transoms,small round upper panels,projecting eaves/brackets and a taller dark geometric portal surround. Fine carvings/art are candidates for broad abstractions,not bespoke textures.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Court contains large and small grey metal domed ablution pavilions on pale columns. Prayer range has central raised portal and grey roof dome;opposite range has pointed open arcade. Cream/light-grey paving with broad dark bands;precise decorative patterns and freestanding lighting can be omitted.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Tall square pale-stone minaret with stacked horizontal bands,mostly plain lower stages,small paired upper pointed fields/round details,projecting bracketed upper gallery and dark open timber stage under shallow pyramidal roof/finial. Courtyard arcade includes repeated pointed bays,parapet/eaves brackets and a light timber canopy. Exact dimensions and present reconstruction state are unverified.

pictures.author: Dosseman
pictures.observed: Reverse court confirms two independent domed column pavilions,pointed arcade on three sides,closed timber fields on prayer facade,cream stone parapet with broad brackets and a timber canopy at a corner. Pavilions have broad rims and faceted/ribbed grey roofs.
